<h1><small>Stage 1 · Sprout · Lesson 2 of 8</small>Read any number</h1>
<div class="fields"><span>Name <u></u></span><span>Date <u class="s"></u></span><span>Time <u class="s"></u></span><span>Score <u class="s"></u> / 20</span><span class="pass">Pass: 18 of 20</span></div>
<div class="howto"><p><b>Today's move.</b> Look at the ones, then the tens. Say the whole number out loud, then write it.</p><p><b>How.</b> Say the number the beads show, then write it in the box.</p><p><b>Stuck?</b> A bead only counts when it touches the middle beam. The top bead is worth 5, each bottom bead is worth 1.</p></div>
